Episode 244. Ambushing the Celestial Race (2)
Crash, bang, screech...!
Along with the cannonade, the sounds of something breaking and shattering, and an object being split, began to mingle. It was because the Grade 1 defense equipment had been activated.
Suddenly, the ground under Luna's feet gave way. Thousands of snake-like red beams burst forth, and Luna had no choice but to take some of them on her body, as usual, and change her position.
"Heh heh, this could be troublesome. Grade 1 defense equipment was deployed here as well...?"
"Master?"
"But since we've already come this deep, let's go on. The concentration of enemy brainwaves will soon be more than twice as high as just now."
As he said, Luna already felt her movements becoming heavier. Imitating Eltiot's neutralization wasn't enough.
"From now on, fight in your usual way, but try to do as I've told you when you have room to. Tsk, I thought this would be intensive training, but it's all wasted, all wasted."
Eltiot showed how to dodge the enemy brainwaves, bombardments, and various traps, clicking his tongue repeatedly.

His movements were not beautiful. Sometimes he sat with his legs stretched out straight, twisting his head left and right, and sometimes he got up from that position by touching the ground and did an aerial somersault before falling flat. He bounced around like a good, resilient ball.
He was entirely different from Luna, who stubbornly took every hit like an unbreakable shield.
'What is that person doing, anyway... Dodging everything like that?'
To Luna, Eltiot seemed like the wind. He could change into any form, and couldn't be caught or confined. Although it was far from graceful.
Fortunately, the Grade 1 defense equipment was activated only after the two of them had entered the city. If it had been activated from the beginning, even approaching would have been a problem.
Crack, snap-!
Krantel sliced a dark barrier in half that had appeared in front of the two. However, the barrier continued to regenerate.
Ordinary attacks seemed unable to keep up with the barrier's formation speed. Luna deployed her final weapon, Shattering Wave.
A colossal wave of light, rising like a dragon's roar from the ground, began to tear the barriers apart. The two could get even closer to the city's interior in the meantime.
"I haven't had a chance to put your advice into practice, Master."

"There's no choice but to do as you see fit. But it's strange; it's about time for the troops to come out directly. Not one of them has come out yet. Let's see, there's the flagship Raviate. Bakl should be managed by Rakiman and the vassal Two Kings."
Soon, the two were able to fully enter the city. However, not only were there no people in the streets, but buildings were nowhere to be seen. It was just a vast wasteland.
"Either it's all hidden underground, or it's been raised into the sky. The citizens of the former Rute Federal must have evacuated in the same way."
The goal of this surprise attack was to seize some of the public facilities deployed by the enemy tribe. With the streets so empty, there was nothing to take.
"I don't know how deep they have hidden it underground, but if I start destroying the ground to find the objects, civilians would get hurt. Shall we break through the sky?"
"Yes."
Luna's gaze reached the blood-red sky, and she clenched her teeth.
Ka-ha-a-a!
As Luna shouted a battle cry and swung her ax-sword, a dazzlingly bright light swept away the enemy's energy.
Currently, there were no airborne fortresses in Bakle.
The firepower of Raviate and the regular fleet alone couldn't perfectly block that vast sword energy. Some of the ships in the front row would be partially damaged.
But the next moment, Luna narrowed her brow and glared again at the sky, which was turning red again.
The massive wave of light pouring from Krantel was blocked by something and scattered before even reaching the fleet's protective shield.
It was a vortex.
A gigantic vortex that whipped the entire sky was pushing back Luna's sword energy. And in the middle of the vortex, a person was descending as if a god had descended.
The enemy tribe's warrior god, Shimat.
Standing in the sky, his glowing heart shone like a star.
"It seems that Zipple still hasn't come to avenge, but you, Runcan, dare to rampage in our territory."
Shimat looked down at Luna. However, he did not keep his eyes on Luna for long and quickly turned his head towards Eltiot.
"Ah, my disciple. That guy has come out."
Luna did not respond but stared at Shimat. Facing the energy flowing from him, chills ran through her entire body.
"It's been a long time, old man. You seem to have been lucky, surviving the Great Seal. Or did the big snake take care of you?"

"If you're talking about time, more than ten thousand years have passed, but you start with a taunt, Enemy Heavenly King. Was the big snake such a soft creature in those days? You seem to have used your head, hiding as a first-class warrior and escaping the Great Seal."
"I couldn't completely escape. The fact that I was sealed as a first-class warrior, Shimat, is true."
"But you're not as nimble as you were back then, are you? Your mind has always been sharp, but you barely escaped destruction."
"If you're jealous, just admit it. You must have used your brain too, old man."
"Jealous? The Sun War can be considered our clear victory. While you failed to leave descendants, we still have the noble race of Lafrarosa."

"Your bad jokes are still the same. As far as I know, that noble race is practically extinct, and only the real Runcandel remains as the sole heir. On the other hand, we only reduced our numbers, but everything else remains the same. We were just trapped in Daebongin for a long time."
"So the first war was our clear victory, and the fight we're going to have now should be considered the second."
"Heh heh... All your brethren have turned to dust, and you think you can fight by clinging to the Vamel Alliance?"
"Well, exactly speaking, from now on, my disciple here will represent the entire race of the clear-minded."
Eltiot pointed at Luna with a confident face. Shimat looked down at Luna with interest for the first time.

"That great Wind Emperor has a human disciple... Indeed, the world has become strange. But it's true that White Whale was among the strongest of that time. However, you don't really think you can bring down the red sky with just one person, do you?"
"Have you forgotten? Our clear-mindedness is one and all."
"No, one is just one. You, having survived alone and looking pitiful, have already proved that."
Eltiot turned his head to Luna without finding an answer.
"Such unlucky things are the enemy race, my disciple. Let's end it today! Don't hold back!"
"I haven't held back, Master."
Luna thought it was not the atmosphere for joking right now.
The god of war had appeared, and the enemy race's air fortresses could send support at any time. If the enemy concentrated their full force on Barkle now, Luna's survival could not be guaranteed.
However, Luna thought that Eltiot must have something to trust, seeing his relaxed attitude. After all, Eltiot was only past his prime, but he was still of a transcendent level.
"I think we've vented enough anger, Wind Emperor. It's time to pay the price for ambushing the enemy's land."
Shimat raised his right hand high above his head.
Then, a massive red sphere, like the sun, was formed on his fingertips. A dark shadow of the gigantic sphere loomed over the fleet and the ground below.
That sphere symbolized the destruction and slaughter carried out by the enemy race in the past. As Shimat lowered his raised hand, the sphere began to fall.
Eltiot also amplified his energy core. His energy, which had been gentle until now, swept away the enemy's wave like a raging tide.
"Take care of Shimat, my disciple. Don't worry about me until I signal!"
First, Eltiot leaped. He jumped up into the sphere and disappeared into it as if falling into the water. Luna had no idea what he was trying to do.
'Did he offset some of it and make a path from inside? Impressive. Then, since he said there's no need to worry...'
Red sword energy formed on Krantel.
Heart Sword Red Moon, she shot the red sword energy at the sphere without hesitation towards where Eltiot had gone. Because the sphere was so large, Luna couldn't make a path without doing so.
It may well have been the heaviest blow she had ever taken in her life. When the sword and the sphere met, Luna felt a shock as if her bones were twisting.
Swoosh-!
But soon after, she was able to cut the sphere in half and locate Shimat again.
Shimat had already closed the distance with Luna, anticipating that the sphere would be split in two. The Sun Sword Tetallon was falling toward Luna's head.
A blood-stained battle-axe and a long sword wrapped in red energy clashed, producing a sharp friction sound. Fragments of energy spurted out between the swords like heavy drops of blood.
“Hoo, mixing swords just once, I see why Cheongpungje chose you as a disciple. Even though you haven't reached Genesis yet, I can feel the power to change destiny.”
“I thought the Red Plutonian clan always ran away like beaten dogs. There was someone like you too.”
The debris of the shattered sphere rained down like lightning. It all fell only towards Luna, following Shimat's will.
While crossing swords with Shimat, Luna continued to be hit by the debris. It was still just an annoyance, but her strong physique was not infinite.
If the fight dragged on, it would eventually break.

'I don't know what the master is trying to do, but it's entirely possible to buy time. But what's the plan to escape afterward? I don't know about the others, but fending off Shimat seems impossible.'
Swoosh! Tetallon brushed Luna's cheek. Krantel passed right in front of his lapel, and Luna felt the gap between Shimat and herself at that moment.
The gap between Genesis and one wandering near Genesis.
“But even Genesis cannot transcend fate every time. You are not my match yet.”
“Really? I think I can handle it......”
While responding, Luna saw another scene of Red Plutonian clan reinforcements coming between the fleets and stopped talking.
Pivil and Patlok, two aerial fortresses, were emerging from the dimensional gate opened in the sky.
“Do you still think you can handle it? White Whale.”
Shimat smiled, and Luna gritted her teeth.
